mc.item.Item.name: net.minecraft.world.item.Item
mc.item.Item.note: 1.21.1 的 Item 构造只需 Item.Properties；物品附加数据走数据组件（Item.Properties#component），覆写 use 时返回 InteractionResultHolder<ItemStack>

mc.item.ItemStack.name: net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack
mc.item.ItemStack.note: 1.20.5 起物品 NBT 已被数据组件取代：getTag/setTag/getOrCreateTag 等不再存在，改用 stack.get/set/update/remove(DataComponents.XXX)，自定义数据放 DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA；序列化 save/parse 需要 HolderLookup.Provider

mc.item.ItemBlock.name: net.minecraft.world.item.BlockItem
mc.item.ItemBlock.note: BlockItem 构造为 (Block, Item.Properties)；NeoForge 推荐用 DeferredRegister.Items#registerSimpleBlockItem 注册

mc.item.CreativeModeTab.name: net.minecraft.world.item.CreativeModeTab
mc.item.CreativeModeTab.note: 自定义页签用 CreativeModeTab.builder() 构建并注册到 Registries.CREATIVE_MODE_TAB；向原版页签加物品在 Mod 总线监听 BuildCreativeModeTabContentsEvent（net.neoforged.neoforge.event）

mc.item.EquipmentSlot.name: net.minecraft.world.entity.EquipmentSlot
mc.item.EquipmentSlot.note: 盔甲部位在 1.21.1 用 ArmorItem.Type（HELMET/CHESTPLATE/LEGGINGS/BOOTS/BODY）表达，EquipmentSlot 仅用于装备栏位

mc.world.item.Tier.name: net.minecraft.world.item.Tier
mc.world.item.Tier.note: 1.21.1 工具等级仍是 Tier 接口（原版实现为 Tiers 枚举）；NeoForge 可用 net.neoforged.neoforge.common.SimpleTier 自建

mc.world.item.ArmorItem.name: net.minecraft.world.item.ArmorItem
mc.world.item.ArmorItem.note: 1.21.1 构造为 ArmorItem(Holder<ArmorMaterial>, ArmorItem.Type, Item.Properties)，盔甲材质是注册表对象（需 DeferredRegister<ArmorMaterial>）

mc.world.item.ArmorMaterial.name: net.minecraft.world.item.ArmorMaterial
mc.world.item.ArmorMaterial.note: 1.20.5~1.21.1 的 ArmorMaterial 是注册到 Registries.ARMOR_MATERIAL 的 record，引用时用 Holder<ArmorMaterial>

mc.block.Block.name: net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block
mc.block.Block.note: 方块交互在 1.20.5 起拆为 useWithoutItem（空手）与 useItemOn（手持物品，返回 ItemInteractionResult），旧 use 覆写需按语义拆分

mc.blockentity.BlockEntity.name: net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity
mc.blockentity.BlockEntity.note: 构造为 (BlockEntityType, BlockPos, BlockState)；NBT 读写为 loadAdditional/saveAdditional(CompoundTag, HolderLookup.Provider)，getUpdateTag 同样带 Provider 参数

mc.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntityT.name: net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntityType
mc.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntityT.note: 1.21.1 用 BlockEntityType.Builder.of(工厂, 方块...).build(null) 创建并以 DeferredRegister 注册

mc.entity.player.ServerPlayer.name: net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer
mc.entity.player.ServerPlayer.note: 打开带数据的菜单用 NeoForge 扩展 serverPlayer.openMenu(menuProvider, buf -> ...)（NetworkHooks 在 NeoForge 中不存在）

mc.entity.EntityType.name: net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType
mc.entity.EntityType.note: 1.21.1 用 EntityType.Builder.of(工厂, MobCategory).sized(w, h).build(字符串 id)；spawn/create 的附加数据参数为 Consumer<Entity>

mc.core.RayTraceResult.name: net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult
mc.core.RayTraceResult.note: HitResult 按用途分为 BlockHitResult / EntityHitResult 子类

mc.core.registries.Registries.name: net.minecraft.core.registries.Registries
mc.core.registries.Registries.note: 注册表 ResourceKey 常量（Registries.ITEM、Registries.CREATIVE_MODE_TAB 等），NeoForge 的 DeferredRegister.create 直接接收它们

mc.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.name: net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries
mc.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.note: 静态注册表实例（BuiltInRegistries.ITEM 等），NeoForge 没有 ForgeRegistries，查询/反查注册名都用它

mc.resources.ResourceLocation.name: net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation
mc.resources.ResourceLocation.note: 1.21 起构造器私有：双参用 ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath，单参用 ResourceLocation.parse，minecraft 命名空间用 withDefaultNamespace

mc.chat.ClickEvent.name: net.minecraft.network.chat.ClickEvent
mc.chat.ClickEvent.note: 1.21.1 仍以 new ClickEvent(ClickEvent.Action, String) 构造

mc.chat.HoverEvent.name: net.minecraft.network.chat.HoverEvent
mc.chat.HoverEvent.note: 1.21.1 以 new HoverEvent(HoverEvent.Action<T>, T) 构造，Action 常量带泛型

mc.util.InteractionResult.name: net.minecraft.world.InteractionResult
mc.util.InteractionResult.note: 1.21.1 仍为枚举（SUCCESS/CONSUME/PASS/FAIL 等），sidedSuccess(isClientSide) 可用

mc.util.InteractionResultHolder.name: net.minecraft.world.InteractionResultHolder
mc.util.InteractionResultHolder.note: InteractionResultHolder<T> 为泛型包装，静态工厂 success/pass/fail/sidedSuccess

mc.damage.DamageSource.name: net.minecraft.world.damagesource.DamageSource
mc.damage.DamageSource.note: 伤害类型数据驱动：用 level.damageSources().generic() 等获取，底层为 Holder<DamageType>

mc.effect.MobEffect.name: net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffect
mc.effect.MobEffect.note: 药水物品类型是 net.minecraft.world.item.alchemy.Potion，与状态效果 MobEffect 区分

mc.effect.MobEffectInstance.name: net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffectInstance
mc.effect.MobEffectInstance.note: 构造签名为 MobEffectInstance(Holder<MobEffect>, ...)，MobEffects 常量本身就是 Holder；自定义效果传 DeferredHolder

mc.enchant.Enchantment.name: net.minecraft.world.item.enchantment.Enchantment
mc.enchant.Enchantment.note: 1.21 起附魔数据驱动：不再子类化/直接构造 Enchantment，改为 data/<ns>/enchantment/*.json + ResourceKey/Holder 引用

mc.enchant.Enchantments.name: net.minecraft.world.item.enchantment.Enchantments
mc.enchant.Enchantments.note: 常量类型为 ResourceKey<Enchantment>，需经 registryAccess.lookupOrThrow(Registries.ENCHANTMENT).getOrThrow(key) 取 Holder

mc.enchant.EnchantmentHelper.name: net.minecraft.world.item.enchantment.EnchantmentHelper
mc.enchant.EnchantmentHelper.note: API 已 Holder 化：等级查询 getItemEnchantmentLevel(Holder<Enchantment>, ItemStack)，效果遍历为 runIterationOn* 形式

mc.syncher.SynchedEntityData.name: net.minecraft.network.syncher.SynchedEntityData
mc.syncher.SynchedEntityData.note: 1.20.5 起默认值在 defineSynchedData(SynchedEntityData.Builder) 中用 builder.define(...) 声明

mc.sound.SoundEvent.name: net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvent
mc.sound.SoundEvent.note: 构造器不公开：用 SoundEvent.createVariableRangeEvent(ResourceLocation) 或 createFixedRangeEvent 创建

mc.sound.SoundEvents.name: net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents
mc.sound.SoundEvents.note: 部分常量类型为 Holder.Reference<SoundEvent>，使用时可能要 .value()

mc.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu.name: net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu
mc.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu.note: 需注册 MenuType：带额外数据的菜单用 IMenuTypeExtension.create((id, inv, buf) -> ...)，服务端 serverPlayer.openMenu(provider, buf -> ...) 打开，客户端在 RegisterMenuScreensEvent 中绑定界面

mc.inventory.Container.name: net.minecraft.world.Container
mc.inventory.Container.note: 原版容器接口；对外暴露物品存储推荐 NeoForge 的 IItemHandler + Capabilities.ItemHandler.BLOCK

mc.client.Screen.name: net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen
mc.client.Screen.note: 1.21.1 渲染入口为 render(GuiGraphics, int, int, float)，绘制方法在 GuiGraphics 上；键鼠回调仍是原始 int/double 参数

mc.client.gui.GuiGraphics.name: net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphics
mc.client.gui.GuiGraphics.note: 1.21.1 的 blit 直接接收纹理 ResourceLocation 与像素 UV，pose() 返回 PoseStack

mc.client.gui.LayeredDraw.name: net.minecraft.client.gui.LayeredDraw
mc.client.gui.LayeredDraw.note: 1.20.5~1.21.5 的 HUD 分层容器；NeoForge 的 RegisterGuiLayersEvent 回调类型为 LayeredDraw.Layer((guiGraphics, deltaTracker) -> ...)

mc.client.resources.PlayerSkin.name: net.minecraft.client.resources.PlayerSkin
mc.client.resources.PlayerSkin.note: 玩家皮肤 record（1.20.2 引入），纹理用 skin.texture()；客户端经 AbstractClientPlayer#getSkin() 获取

mc.client.KeyMapping.name: net.minecraft.client.KeyMapping
mc.client.KeyMapping.note: 1.21.1 构造为 KeyMapping(名称, [InputConstants.Type,] 键码, 字符串分类)，在 Mod 总线 RegisterKeyMappingsEvent 中注册

mc.client.BlockEntityRenderer.name: net.minecraft.client.renderer.blockentity.BlockEntityRenderer
mc.client.BlockEntityRenderer.note: 1.21.1 render 签名为 (T, float, PoseStack, MultiBufferSource, int, int)，在 EntityRenderersEvent.RegisterRenderers 注册

mc.client.renderer.entity.EntityRenderer.name: net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.EntityRenderer
mc.client.renderer.entity.EntityRenderer.note: 1.21.1 的 render 直接接收实体实例：render(T, float, float, PoseStack, MultiBufferSource, int)

mc.client.renderer.ItemBlockRenderTypes.name: net.minecraft.client.renderer.ItemBlockRenderTypes
mc.client.renderer.ItemBlockRenderTypes.note: NeoForge 中更推荐在方块模型 JSON 里写 "render_type"；代码方式 ItemBlockRenderTypes.setRenderLayer 已不推荐

mc.world.food.FoodProperties.name: net.minecraft.world.food.FoodProperties
mc.world.food.FoodProperties.note: FoodProperties 是数据组件（DataComponents.FOOD）；Builder 方法为 nutrition/saturationModifier/alwaysEdible/fast

mc.world.ItemInteractionResult.name: net.minecraft.world.ItemInteractionResult
mc.world.ItemInteractionResult.note: 方块 useItemOn 的返回类型（SUCCESS/CONSUME/PASS_TO_DEFAULT_BLOCK_INTERACTION 等）

mc.network.RegistryFriendlyByteBuf.name: net.minecraft.network.RegistryFriendlyByteBuf
mc.network.RegistryFriendlyByteBuf.note: FriendlyByteBuf 的子类，额外携带 RegistryAccess；两者都存在，不是改名关系

forge.Mod.EventBusSubscriber.name: net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber
forge.Mod.EventBusSubscriber.note: NeoForge 的自动订阅注解是顶层类 EventBusSubscriber（不再是 Mod 的内部类）：@EventBusSubscriber(modid = MODID, bus = EventBusSubscriber.Bus.MOD/GAME)；若源码写成 @Mod.EventBusSubscriber，需改为独立导入

forge.MinecraftForge.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.common.NeoForge
forge.MinecraftForge.note: 游戏事件总线为 NeoForge.EVENT_BUS（对应 MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS）

forge.FMLEnvironment.name: net.neoforged.fml.loading.FMLEnvironment
forge.FMLEnvironment.note: 1.21.1 中当前运行侧用静态字段 FMLEnvironment.dist，开发/生产环境用 FMLEnvironment.production

forge.DeferredRegister.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.registries.DeferredRegister
forge.DeferredRegister.note: DeferredRegister.create(Registries.XXX, MODID) 或专用的 DeferredRegister.createItems/createBlocks；register 返回 DeferredHolder（物品/方块为 DeferredItem/DeferredBlock）；在 @Mod 构造器中 REGISTER.register(modEventBus)

forge.RegistryObject.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.registries.DeferredHolder
forge.RegistryObject.note: RegistryObject -> DeferredHolder<R, T>：实现了原版 Holder，取值 get()/value() 均可，且可直接当 Holder 传给需要 Holder 的 API；泛型多了注册表基类型参数

forge.ForgeConfigSpec.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.common.ModConfigSpec
forge.ForgeConfigSpec.note: ForgeConfigSpec -> ModConfigSpec（Builder 用法基本一致）；注册改为在 @Mod 构造器中 modContainer.registerConfig(ModConfig.Type.COMMON, SPEC)

forge.ForgeCapabilities.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.capabilities.Capabilities
forge.ForgeCapabilities.note: NeoForge 能力按目标分类：Capabilities.ItemHandler.BLOCK / .ENTITY / .ITEM 等（不是 ForgeCapabilities.ITEM_HANDLER）；查询用 level.getCapability(Capabilities.ItemHandler.BLOCK, pos, side)，提供者在 RegisterCapabilitiesEvent 中注册，不存在 LazyOptional

forge.capabilities.ICapabilityProvider.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.capabilities.ICapabilityProvider
forge.capabilities.ICapabilityProvider.note: NeoForge 的 ICapabilityProvider<O, C, T> 是在 RegisterCapabilitiesEvent 中登记的函数式提供者 (对象, 上下文) -> 能力实例，方块实体不再实现它、也没有 getCapability 覆写

forge.util.INBTSerializable.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.common.util.INBTSerializable
forge.util.INBTSerializable.note: 签名带注册表访问：serializeNBT(HolderLookup.Provider) / deserializeNBT(HolderLookup.Provider, T)

forge.fluids.FluidStack.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.fluids.FluidStack
forge.fluids.FluidStack.note: FluidStack 也改为数据组件（不再有 NBT tag），构造 new FluidStack(流体或 Holder, 数量)

forge.lifecycle.commonSetup.name: net.neoforged.fml.event.lifecycle.FMLCommonSetupEvent
forge.lifecycle.commonSetup.note: 在 Mod 总线监听（@Mod 构造器 modEventBus.addListener(...)）；注册内容请用 DeferredRegister

forge.lifecycle.serverStarting.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.event.server.ServerStartingEvent
forge.lifecycle.serverStarting.note: 在游戏总线（NeoForge.EVENT_BUS）上用 @SubscribeEvent 监听

forge.lifecycle.serverStopping.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.event.server.ServerStoppingEvent
forge.lifecycle.serverStopping.note: 在游戏总线（NeoForge.EVENT_BUS）上用 @SubscribeEvent 监听

forge.event.RegisterEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.registries.RegisterEvent
forge.event.RegisterEvent.note: event.register(Registries.XXX, helper -> helper.register(id, 对象))，一般直接用 DeferredRegister 即可

forge.event.PlayerTickEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.PlayerTickEvent
forge.event.PlayerTickEvent.note: NeoForge 的 tick 事件按阶段拆成子类：监听 PlayerTickEvent.Pre 或 PlayerTickEvent.Post，不再判断 event.phase

forge.event.ServerTickEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.ServerTickEvent
forge.event.ServerTickEvent.note: 监听 ServerTickEvent.Pre / ServerTickEvent.Post，没有 phase 字段

forge.event.ClientTickEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.ClientTickEvent
forge.event.ClientTickEvent.note: 监听 ClientTickEvent.Pre / ClientTickEvent.Post（游戏总线），没有 phase 字段

forge.event.RenderGuiOverlayEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RenderGuiLayerEvent
forge.event.RenderGuiOverlayEvent.note: 对应物为 RenderGuiLayerEvent.Pre/Post（按层 id 过滤，id 常量见 VanillaGuiLayers）；自定义 HUD 层在 Mod 总线 RegisterGuiLayersEvent 中注册

forge.event.RenderLevelStageEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RenderLevelStageEvent
forge.event.RenderLevelStageEvent.note: 1.21.1 仍是单一事件，用 event.getStage() == Stage.AFTER_XXX 区分阶段

forge.event.RegisterGuiOverlaysEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RegisterGuiLayersEvent
forge.event.RegisterGuiOverlaysEvent.note: RegisterGuiOverlaysEvent 的对应物：Mod 总线 RegisterGuiLayersEvent，registerAbove/registerBelow(VanillaGuiLayers.XXX, id, layer)，1.21.1 的 layer 是 LayeredDraw.Layer((guiGraphics, deltaTracker) -> ...)

forge.network.PacketDistributor.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.network.PacketDistributor
forge.network.PacketDistributor.note: NeoForge 的 PacketDistributor 是静态发送工具：sendToServer(payload) / sendToPlayer(serverPlayer, payload) / sendToPlayersTrackingEntity(entity, payload) 等，不再是 Forge 的 PacketTarget 写法

forge.event.GatherDataEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.data.event.GatherDataEvent
forge.event.GatherDataEvent.note: 1.21.1 为单一事件，用 event.includeClient()/includeServer() 区分资源与数据

forge.ModContainer.name: net.neoforged.fml.ModContainer
forge.ModContainer.note: 由加载器注入 @Mod 构造器；registerConfig/registerExtensionPoint 在它上面调用

forge.ModLoadingContext.name: net.neoforged.fml.ModLoadingContext
forge.ModLoadingContext.note: 1.21 起 ModLoadingContext#registerConfig 已移除，改用注入的 ModContainer#registerConfig

forge.lifecycle.clientSetup.name: net.neoforged.fml.event.lifecycle.FMLClientSetupEvent
forge.lifecycle.clientSetup.note: 在 Mod 总线监听；菜单界面绑定请改用 RegisterMenuScreensEvent

forge.capabilities.RegisterCapabilitiesE.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.capabilities.RegisterCapabilitiesEvent
forge.capabilities.RegisterCapabilitiesE.note: NeoForge 的 RegisterCapabilitiesEvent 用来登记能力提供者：event.registerBlockEntity(Capabilities.ItemHandler.BLOCK, 类型, (be, side) -> ...)，与 Forge 同名事件（注册能力类型）语义不同

forge.client.ConfigScreenHandler.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.client.gui.IConfigScreenFactory
forge.client.ConfigScreenHandler.note: 配置界面：modContainer.registerExtensionPoint(IConfigScreenFactory.class, (container, parent) -> new ConfigurationScreen(container, parent))

forge.client.VanillaGuiOverlay.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.client.gui.VanillaGuiLayers
forge.client.VanillaGuiOverlay.note: 原版 HUD 层 id 常量（ResourceLocation），供 RegisterGuiLayersEvent / RenderGuiLayerEvent 使用

forge.common.ForgeSpawnEggItem.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.common.DeferredSpawnEggItem
forge.common.ForgeSpawnEggItem.note: 刷怪蛋：new DeferredSpawnEggItem(实体类型 Supplier, 底色, 斑点色, Item.Properties)

forge.common.IForgeMenuType.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.common.extensions.IMenuTypeExtension
forge.common.IForgeMenuType.note: 带额外数据的菜单类型：IMenuTypeExtension.create((windowId, inv, buf) -> ...)

forge.common.Tags.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.common.Tags
forge.common.Tags.note: 通用标签常量，命名空间为 c:（Tags.Items.INGOTS_IRON 等）

forge.event.EntityItemPickupEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.event.entity.player.ItemEntityPickupEvent
forge.event.EntityItemPickupEvent.note: 拾取事件分为 ItemEntityPickupEvent.Pre / Post

forge.event.LivingTickEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.EntityTickEvent
forge.event.LivingTickEvent.note: 实体 tick 改为 EntityTickEvent.Pre / Post（对所有实体触发，需自行判断 LivingEntity）

forge.event.RenderTickEvent.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RenderFrameEvent
forge.event.RenderTickEvent.note: 渲染帧事件为 RenderFrameEvent.Pre / Post

neoforge.attachment.AttachmentType.name: net.neoforged.neoforge.attachment.AttachmentType
neoforge.attachment.AttachmentType.note: 数据附件类型：AttachmentType.builder(() -> 默认值).serialize(codec).build()，注册到 NeoForgeRegistries.Keys.ATTACHMENT_TYPES
